title: product-candidate-provider input
description: Step 2 / Phase 4. Candidate generation only -- this skill never recommends. solution_plan is required; the rest narrow the result.

client_profile.description: Canonical ClientProfile (envelope or bare payload). Used only for eligibility.

coverage_gap_analysis.description: Canonical CoverageGapAnalysis. Used for gap-domain fallback when solution_type is GENERAL.

solution_plan.description: Canonical SolutionPlan. One strategy per gap.

knowledge_evidence.description: Canonical KnowledgeEvidence. Absent or empty => every candidate gets EVIDENCE_MISSING.

requested_product_ids.description: Optional explicit product ids. Any id not in the catalog is rejected with PRODUCT_NOT_IN_CATALOG.
